comparison.objective: Open a casement window to the last peg-stay hole and secure it there.
comparison.physical_skill: Lift a stay clear of intermediate holes while moving the sash, then lower the correct hole over a pin.
comparison.success_condition: Last hole captured on the pin, hands clear, sash and stay still; glass intrusion or an unsecured stay fails.
comparison.reason: Tests coordinated articulated repositioning and hole-on-pin capture, not tool-driven screw adjustment or torque-preserving lockup.
